_note: The permanent perk tree (Command Center). Each lane is a ladder: a perk opens once you have spent `needs` points in its lane. Ranked perks take a point per rank up to `ranks`; keystones (◆) change how a run plays and cost more. Rows at 18 and 30 are pick-one (`choice`: only one perk of a group can be owned; right-click it to swap). A `repeatable` perk (each lane's Mastery, at the bottom) takes points without end, so a full tree never strands points; it doesn't count in the tree's total. `effect` names what the perk does in MetaPerkRegistry.Apply; `value` (and `value2`) are per rank. Points: every `perWaves` waves cleared in a run, `ascendantKill` per enemy Ascendant killed, plus the first-time milestone points in milestones.json.
